stack: Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript, react-router-dom 7, lucide-react icons, inline-style TOKENS (src/styles/tokens.ts) + global.css, Appwrite (auth, TablesDB, Functions) with a local IndexedDB mode when no Appwrite env is set; PWA via vite-plugin-pwa; two entries: index.html (Janka) and axle.html (Janka AXLE)

surfaces.name: Janka web app (desktop shell)
surfaces.layout: Left sidebar (248px, light #F7F7F8, scrolls, profile row pinned at bottom) + floating top bar card (64px tall, 24px radius, inside a 12px/32px gutter, max width 1440px). Content max width 1440px, 32px padding. Below 1024px the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer with scrim and a round hamburger button appears in the top bar.

brand.logo: Sidebar: JankaWordmark (src/brand/JankaMark.tsx, drawn J-A-N-K-A with signal ticks), 22px. Top bar: BrandPill = AntaraX 'A' (src/brand/antarax-mark.svg, links to https://antarax.ai) + raised white chip with JankaIcon + text 'Janka' (links to /)
brand.eyebrow: TRACK · FORECAST · UNLOCK (JetBrains Mono 10px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em, under the wordmark)
brand.other: No version/build text. Page <title> is 'Janka — Track. Forecast. Unlock.' (index.html:7).

user_menu: Sign out… (signed-in only; inline confirm 'Sign out of Janka on this device?' with Cancel / Sign out)
global_controls.sign_out: Profile menu, bottom of sidebar, with inline confirmation; warns if unsynced changes are queued

global_controls.impersonation: none; a suspension banner (PauseCircle) shows above content when REKA suspends the organisation (RoleGuard.tsx:39)
other: Site selector pill in the top bar (MapPin + native select 'All sites' / each site), hidden when only one site
Page title h1 in the top bar (from navConfig titleForPath)
Phone-sized touch devices are redirected to the /m scanner shell unless 'Use the desktop site' was chosen

surfaces.responsive: ≥1181px: full top bar (site field, sync label, org name pill). ≤1180px: site field narrows to 160px, org pill folds to a 44px Building2 icon. <1024px: sidebar becomes a fixed off-canvas drawer (translateX, 0.2s, scrim rgba(20,32,40,.4)), hamburger 'Open navigation' 44px round button appears, top bar gutter 16px, main padding 16px; navigating closes the drawer. ≤760px: top bar card 58px, site and sync fold to 44px round icon buttons, labels visually hidden. ≤560px: page title hidden visually (kept for screen readers). Pointer-coarse ≤720px redirects to /m/scan.
surfaces.active_state: Active nav item: background primarySubtle #FFF4E0, text #0B0E14 semibold, icon in primary orange #FB9800 at stroke 2.2; inactive text and icon #6B7280, stroke 1.8, 8px radius, 120ms background/colour transition
surfaces.fonts: Poppins 400/500/600/700 for UI (@fontsource), JetBrains Mono 400/500 for numbers, SKU codes, eyebrow, org pill. Nav items 14px, group labels 11px uppercase 0.06em, nav icons 17px, top bar title 18px semibold
surfaces.a11y: Focus rings in the shell are ink #0B0E14 2px (top bar controls, profile menu); form controls focus in orange with an orange tint halo. Profile menu is a proper role=menu with arrow keys, Home/End, Esc. Top bar targets are 44px. prefers-reduced-motion stops drawer transitions, splash/thinking marks, tour pulse and spinners. Drawer scrim is aria-hidden; the hamburger has no aria-expanded.
surfaces.role_variants: Roles: admin, manager, worker. Admin and manager see the full nav. Worker loses Kits, Locations, RFID, Forecasting, Replenishment, PO Drafts, Simulation, Risk & Exposure, Capital and Reports; the Plan group disappears entirely, Watch keeps only Alerts. Role restrictions hide items; plan gating shows them with a badge. RoleGuard blocks URL entry to hidden routes. Local mode (no Appwrite) has no sign-in and lets you simulate role and plan in Settings.
